name: United Stables
oneLiner: U is a BVI-issued dollar stablecoin backed by a variable mix of cash, U.S. Treasury bills, and approved fiat-referenced stablecoins.
collateral: Variable reserve mix of cash, U.S. Treasury bills, and fiat-referenced stablecoins approved by United Stables.
pegMechanism: Smart contracts mint U 1:1 only upon receipt of USD or whitelisted stablecoins (USDC, USDT, USD1); redemption burns U and returns USD or stablecoins; on-chain oracles enforce total supply never exceeds collateral

genius.notes: United Stables states $U has not obtained registration, authorization, or licensing under the GENIUS Act.

sourcesChecked: OCC GENIUS Act proposed rule and public releases
United Stables website (u.tech) regulatory disclosure — issuer explicitly states no GENIUS Act authorization obtained
United Stables terms page regulatory disclosure
Public U.S. permitted-issuer, state-qualified, official-application, and foreign-exception materials
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: United Stables' own site carries an explicit disclosure that $U has not obtained registration, authorization, or licensing under the GENIUS Act of 2025; no public GENIUS approval, application, or foreign registration source was located on re-verification 2026-06-07.

mintAuthority.summary: U is issuer-operated; Ethereum/BSC token ownership resolves to a 2/4 Safe that controls mint/admin authority.

controls.label: U token owner Safe
controls.evidence: Ethereum/BSC token owner reads resolve to this Safe; getThreshold() returned 2 and getOwners() returned 4 owners at Ethereum block 25165911. Worker Safe API review found no modules and zero guard.

review.evidence: United Stables presents U as issuer-operated, and token owner reads identify a 2/4 Safe as the on-chain mint/admin owner path.

reserves.name: Cash, U.S. Treasury bills, and fiat-referenced stablecoins (variable mix)
